draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on most of the six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite, with Arbor-GBT higher only on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1 (81.6>80.9), r2 (88.3>87.1), r4 (76.4>75.6), r5 (84.9>84.1), r6 (90.2>89.0) — five of six; only r3 (Ivel-Fraud) favors Arbor-GBT (92.8>92.3). "Most" is accurate but understates the exact count of five of six.
